name: Downloads
author: Robson
description: Self-contained yt-dlp download manager with a Bun daemon, Systemd service, and Quickshell bar widget. • Concurrent downloads via an async Bun daemon (pool of 3, overflow queued) • Native Chromium and Brave integration with weighted media detection that skips ads • RAM-cached thumbnails in tmpfs, no SSD wear • Quickshell widget with live progress, queue, cancel and clear • CLI client for full terminal control • Systemd user service for reliable background downloads

barWidget.description: Ícone na barra com visualização e controle de progresso de downloads em tempo real.
